character.appendages: Only the two attached flexible top feelers may extend beyond the compact body. They rise together, sweep backward, splay into a V or flatten with the body. Do not add arms, legs, paws, wings, a separate tail or detached particles.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas is 64x64 with source origin [23,42]. All 82 Main/Sub slots use that common origin. Compact forms sit near the origin, upright forms extend to y=-29, diagonal forms keep their authored displacement and the far-right low state reaches x=33. Canonical aliases and translations remain authoritative.
character.faceAndExpression: The small light face changes by pose. Neutral compact cells keep a narrow readable face; upright effort or alarm cells expose a large dark opening with a red lower interior; diagonal poses shift the face toward travel; low, rear, silhouette, stone and flattened states hide or compress it.
character.locomotion: The whole body rocks between compact side rests, compresses low, rises into a narrow upright stretch, leans diagonally, makes short local lifts and folds into broad horizontal poses. Preserve raw sequence IDs and timing; do not assign or invent action names.
character.morphology: Tiny ground-contact capsule or seed-pod body with one compact central mass and two long flexible top feelers. The replacement may reinterpret the surface, face window and feelers, but must remain a limbless compact body that can stretch upright and fold sideways.
character.restraint: Main cells 026-042 are the restrained block, including aliases. A gold-brown external binding wraps the central body while the character repeats compact, upright open-mouth, diagonal and low folded poses. The binding follows body rotation and compression and must not become anatomy.
character.specialStates: Main 043/045 are orange-red special-color states; 046 is the black upright silhouette; 047 is the black compact silhouette; 060 is stone-gray; 061 is a distinct very low pale state displaced to the right; 063 is the white evolution silhouette. Derive palette and silhouette states deterministically only when alpha equivalence proves the contour.
